prog='''import math
from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    bg=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    res=[]
    for row in grid:
        i=0
        while i<len(row):
            v=row[i]
            if v!=bg:
                j=i
                while j<len(row) and row[j]==v: j+=1
                res.append(v); i=j
            else: i+=1
    res.sort(reverse=True)
    w=len(set(res))+1 if res else 1
    n=len(res); h=max(1,math.ceil(n/w))
    flat=res+[0]*(w*h-n)
    return [flat[i*w:(i+1)*w] for i in range(h)]
'''
